V1.3.5 adds local HEIC/HEIF image preview and thumbnail conversion. Original files remain stored with the existing client-side encryption; this release does not change encrypted payloads, key derivation, AAD, metadata transactions, SQLite schema, backup container version, or client mutation protocol.

The HEIC decoder is lazy-loaded locally, bounded by a 32 MiB input limit, and distributed with its LGPL-3.0 license notice and license text. Release validation covers the HEIC unit tests, frontend build, full project checks, and Linux amd64/arm64 package contents.

localState.plaintextPolicy: encrypted with K_local before IndexedDB persistence

sqlite.migrationPolicy: forward only; after a schema-changing migration, restore the matching pre-migration database and binary before rollback

clientMutationProtocol.acceptance: exact match only; reject missing, older, and future versions before reading mutation bodies

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
